android.desc:
Discover Jow: The Ultimate Free Recipe and Grocery Shopping App.

Say goodbye to "What's for dinner?" with Jow. Our app offers personalized recipes and seamless grocery shopping, tailored to your tastes and household needs. Connect with your favorite stores like H-E-B, Kroger, Instacart, Ralphs, and more to shop and plan meals effortlessly.

Whether you're looking to simplify meal planning or streamline grocery shopping, Jow makes it quick and easy - download now to get started!

HOW JOW WORKS

1. Input your kitchen appliances, household size, and dietary preferences. Jow creates a customized recipe catalog just for you.
2. Select from thousands of easy recipes.
3. Jow generates a smart cart based on your household needs, ensuring you only buy what you need.
4. Add any additional staple items to your cart 
5. Jow will automatically order all the ingredients from your selected supermarket.
6. Follow step-by-step cooking instructions and video tutorials for delicious results.

JOW FEATURES

- Family-Friendly: Perfect for feeding any size household and reducing grocery shopping stress.
- Time-Saving: Quickly decide on weekly meal planning and get all the ingredients ordered from your nearest supermarket.
- Money-Saving: Save an average of 10% on grocery costs with smart cart optimization and exclusive deals. Manage your budget effectively with our budget menu feature.
- Eat Better: Access a wide range of recipes, including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options.
- Avoid Food Waste: Buy only what you need and cut down on unnecessary expenses and food waste.

JOIN OVER 7 MILION USERS WORLDWIDE

Join millions who trust Jow for meal inspiration, smart shopping, and hassle-free grocery pickup or delivery.

WHAT OUR USERS SAY

"Genuinely a life-changing app. It connects to my local grocery store and makes everything so easy to order. Definitely recommend this app." Karen, Houston

“Jow has made meal planning and grocery shopping incredibly affordable and convenient. It’s healthier and more budget-friendly than any meal kit, and my family loves it!” - Morgan, Los Angeles

"I've been using this app for two months and really like how much time and money it saves. It has also increased our vegetable intake." Taylor, San Antonio

Download Jow today and transform your meal planning and grocery shopping experience!

quotes.text: I know the app "Jow" which is mostly used to create a chosen number of meal and to give you the exact quantity of ingredient needed from preparing the meal (with recipe instruction) and not so much "designed" for planning, but I use it for planning what I will eat for each weeks : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wishop.dev.jow&hl=fr&gl=US
